summary: Validación local fail-closed y trazabilidad de modelos GLB auténticos para los seis huecos de Janus; sin reconstruir dashboards ni generar imágenes falsas.
dataClassification: local asset metadata and hashes; private GLB source remains outside public repository
invariants: Only glTF 2.0 with embedded BIN geometry is accepted for preview.
GLB is limited to existing PWA budgets; Draco and KTX2 remain unsupported.
All receipts are preview-only and require independent PWA visual acceptance.
Hyper3D outputs and unreviewed assets are NEVER authorized as training data.
Core keeps model selection, approvals, persistence and publication authority.
Existing six character slots and approved dashboard layouts remain unchanged.
No network, purchase, training, deployment or secret access in this module.
reuseNotes: Use inspectForgeGlb and makeForgeReceipt from src/index.ts; host stores receipts locally and imports models using existing PWA JanusCreatureSlot, with visual approval.
